name: Asaoka Chieri
source: A very shy girl Ryuuga runs into in the nurses office when he's waiting to see a nurse. She gets some antibacterial medicine and leaves quickly making it the only time the two meet. Although he doesn't know her very well he still chooses her to take part in hide and seek along with the others.
